He was once a kind boy — loyal to family, faithful to love, and full of hope.
But kindness means nothing in a world that spits on your loyalty.
Roman died betrayed.
His stepbrother beat him.
His girlfriend cheated.
His family used him like a slave — and when the world ended, they threw him to the undead.
But death wasn’t the end.
Roman was reborn — weeks before the apocalypse that would erase humanity.
And this time?
No more mercy. No more weakness.
This time, Roman builds his empire in the shadows, manipulates nations, steals resources before the collapse, and creates a stronghold while the world sleeps peacefully — blind to the hell that’s coming.
> What?! A supermarket in New York is completely wiped out overnight!
Japan’s largest food storage warehouse was found empty — zero inventory, massive losses.
Similar cases in South Korea and Australia? No trace, no witnesses. Just... gone.
One man is preparing.
One man is rising.
Roman.
But just when he thinks he's the only one pulling the strings in the dark...
Others begin to move.
Reincarnated. Ruthless. Just like him.
The game is no longer survival.
It's domination.
In this new world, only one king can rule from the shadows.…

i-can-see-evolution-paths:
On Beast Awakening Day, Arthur Cronwall receives the worst possible combination in Greenleaf history.
F-Rank Talent.
Goblin Contract Beast.
The ceremony erupts in laughter. To everyone else, goblins are the weakest monsters alive—creatures destined to stay weak forever. Then Arthur awakens a hidden Talent.
Evolution Path Vision.
A power that reveals every possible evolution hidden inside his beasts. And when he looked at the frightened goblin trembling beside him...
[Goblin] --> [Goblin Warrior] --> [Goblin Commander] --> [Goblin King]
A king? If a goblin can become a king... What else is the world wrong about?
Arthur looked at the trembling goblin and smiled.
“They call you disgusting.”
“A mistake.”
“Don't you want to see their faces when you prove them wrong?”
The goblin hesitated and Arthur reached out his hand.
“Come on.”
“Our story starts here.”
Together, they begin turning the world's weakest monsters into legends. Their journey leads through forgotten kingdoms, extinct evolutions, ancient civilizations, and secrets buried beneath history itself. Because some evolution paths don't simply lead to stronger beasts.
They lead to a truth the world was never meant to discover.

infinite-technology-system:
Rejected by companies. Buried in debt. Running on caffeine and stubbornness.
Dhiraj Wagh thought his future would end in another overcrowded office cubicle like millions of other engineering graduates.
Then a laboratory accident awakened the Infinite Technology System.
An ancient technological inheritance left behind by a civilization that once ruled among the stars.
The System does not give superpowers.
It gives technology.
Revolutionary batteries.
Advanced AI systems.
Next-generation materials.
Industrial technologies decades ahead of modern Earth.
With every breakthrough, Dhiraj earns access to even greater knowledge.
What begins as a desperate attempt to escape poverty soon turns into something far larger.
Corporations start hunting his secrets.
Governments begin watching him.
Entire industries destabilize because of his inventions.
And somewhere beyond Earth, something is waiting.
The extinct creators of the System were not destroyed by war.
They were erased by a cosmic intelligence that eliminates civilizations once they advance too far.
Now humanity is accelerating toward the same threshold.…

The forensic doctor Bai Family Grandma calmly dug out a Crystal Core, “Its lower jaw protrudes, clearly an underbite, even with makeup it wouldn't look good.”
Bai Yifan shook while holding a sack to collect Crystal Cores, bravely holding back tears.…
reborn-as-an-evolving-monster:
In a world of Monsters and Mythical Creatures, he was reborn.
Not as a Human, but as a Monster.
'So you're telling me I can't leave this place?'
[You must first clear the Dungeon's Ten Floors.]
'Only then, will I be able to check out this new world?'
[You must build your strength.]
'By using my “Devourer” and “Evolving Monster” Unique Titles, huh?'
script-of-reincarnation:
A drop of water can fill the vast ocean, a grain of sand can contain the myriad realms.
This is a world of conflict where prodigies rise like meteors, aspiring to become Emperors and Gods, to hold eternity in their hands and control their own fate.
Yet, how many can truly reach such heights?
Lu Yang transmigrated to this world at a young age, believing himself to be the main character who was destined for greatness until reality struck him hard.
He was not special, no different from any other native of this world.
Developing cautiously for decades, yet unable to even breakthrough to the second realm of cultivation, he died in regret due to a conspiracy he was involuntarily drawn into.
[Life Evaluation: An ordinary person with no special achievements, with ambition but no ability, dying in boundless regret, like a spark being extinguished.]
It was only after his death did the Script of Reincarnation appear before him.
The fate trajectory of each life can be transformed into Reincarnation Points, allowing him to improve his talent, comprehension, background, and luck in the next life.…
she-only-cares-about-cultivation:
Tangyuan was an excellent pulmonologist who, after an accidental death, acquired a system.
By completing tasks in various fast-travel worlds, she would fulfill virtue and acquire a new life.
The system chosen for her was the farming stream system, which included time-traveling through ancient times, the Republican era, apocalypse, modern times, and more.
This fulfilled her joy of earning from nothing and also allowed her to enjoy the study of various professions within the fast-travel system.
stranger-in-my-ass:
What do you do when you're at a concert, dancing and trying to forget a colleague you've had a crush on, then suddenly a stranger grabs you from behind, and fucks you till you're too weak to stand?
Yeah, that's my situation right now.
Crushing on the handsome Alex - who, by the way, doesn’t know I exist - has made me make VERY crazy life decisions, including seeking the help of an arrogant love doctor, and disguising myself as a man just to work with him in his new company.
And now, the same stranger from the concert, shows up behind me whenever, and fucks the hell outta me until I now crave him.
Did I also mention that I hate my new boss? Yeah, Max Wellington is just so annoying, and it seems the feeling is mutual cause he hates me too.
strongest-medical-saint:
He returned with a vigorous presence, equipped with a Heaven-reaching Innate Ability.
He could heal, tell fortunes, refine medicines, set formations, and refine talismans…
“There’s nothing in this world that I can’t do!” — Shen Feng.
the-dungeon-lord-women-power-and-monster:
In a world divided between ambitious human kingdoms, the master craftsmen of the Egbere, and the spiritual Ayanru, an ordinary young adventurer from the Kingdom of Aramode dreams of nothing more than earning enough to give his uncle a better life.
He has no legendary bloodline, no divine blessing, and no destiny waiting for him.
Everything changes when a forgotten dungeon chooses him as its Lord.
What begins as a struggle for survival soon becomes the foundation of something the world has never seen. As the dungeon grows, so does his ambition. He must gather loyal companions, forge alliances across ancient races, uncover long-buried secrets, and transform a hidden sanctuary into a kingdom powerful enough to stand against empires, monsters, and legends.
In a world where everyone seeks power, one ordinary man may prove that the greatest legacy isn't becoming the strongest....
It's building a civilization that changes history.
Author here all I need you to do is collect, engage and gift. Thanks for your support.
the-empress-wants-a-divorce-every-day:
Feng Qing, a top surgeon from the 21st century, wakes up in a body no one wants — married off to Rong Ling, the most powerful Regent in Dayan, a man who makes it abundantly clear:
“Do you think you're worthy of marrying this king? Foolish.”
While he keeps his distance, she keeps herself busy, saving lives with medical knowledge centuries ahead of its time, collecting debts from those who wronged the original body's owner, and planning her exit strategy.
Later, he became the New Emperor—
“Qing Qing, from now on, you are my Empress.”
“Not interested.”
the-kings-game:
In the King’s game, the [King]’s order is absolute and has the power to create rules. As the owner of a special physique, Gu Huai was selected by the system to participate in the game.
“Win the game and become the [King], and you can obtain whatever it is you desire.”
the-martial-god-released:
Meet Baek Ri-hyun, the renowned legendary martial artist of murim and was given the title Martial God.
In a battle against the Heavenly Demon who has transcended mortality, Baek Ri-hyun was suddenly pulled by an unknown forces to bring him to another world by the power of a goddess who is in need of help from different people, not knowing she pulled a god into her world.
Blessed with a system to aid the growth of the future heroes, I don't think he'll need something like it as he ventures the new world.
the-older-brother-of-my-student-is-my-se:
On the first day Yuna became a class teacher, she became well-known in school because of her looks. On the second day of becoming a class teacher, a student secretly took photos of her with his phone and was called to the principal’s office with his Guardian. The person who showed up turned out to be Yuna’s university crush, Xiao Chen.
To Yuna’s surprise, Xiao Chen was the elder brother of the very student whose class she manages. She also realized that this rebellious student causes trouble two or three days out of every week, indirectly giving them many chances to meet.
…
When they reunite again, Yuna is puzzled. Wasn’t Xiao Chen a poor young master in the past? How come he’s now driving luxury cars and living in mansions?
Xiao Chen is also puzzled. Wasn’t Yuna a rich daddy’s girl in the past? How come she’s now dressing plainly and squeezing onto public transport??
…
In the eyes of her students, Yuna is very beautiful but has always been diligent and thrifty, with little interest in money.
However, one day a Rolls Royce showed up outside school, waiting. Upon seeing Yuna, the chauffeur respectfully opened the door for her, “Miss Yuna, please get in.…
the-reincarnation-of-the-kingmaker:
After an unforeseen circumstance, Kayn is abruptly transported back in time, accompanied by someone he once considered his most significant foe.
As he delves deeper into the past, Kayn discovers the truth behind the events that led to his betrayal by both his guild and allies, as well as the agonizing reality of being abandoned by those he was sworn to protect.
Fueled by a deep desire for retribution, Kayn vows to take matters into his own hands and right the wrongs of the past, proclaiming his intent to become a Kingmaker and shape the future according to his own vision.
the-scorned-omega-and-her-alpha:
In a world ruled by twelve celestial Lycan packs, Hazel Lockwood is a stain on the Gemini line: born without a wolf, without a mark, and without a twin. Treated as little more than a servant by her own father and his new family, she endures the lash, the humiliation, and the certainty that she will die forgotten in the shadows of Tideclaw.
Then the King of all Lycans arrives.
Alpha Conan Valerius Black does not come for politics or alliances. He comes for a bride. And when the Alpha of Tideclaw tries to pass off his despised, markless daughter as the offering, Conan does the unthinkable.
He accepts her.
Now Hazel is dragged from the dungeon into the glittering courts of Hellington Palace, claimed by the most feared Alpha alive, surrounded by enemies who would rather see her dead than crowned, and bound to a king who recoils at her scent yet refuses to let her go.
But the markless Omega may be far more than a discarded runt.
And when her blood finally awakens, it won't just change her fate, it will drown them all in fire.
the-villainess-returns-with-a-system:
A classic villainess/heroine tale that puts a new twist on the genre. This Industrial Era fantasy tells the story of Nadia—a secret agent with a dry love life and an unhealthy addiction to visual novels—as she Transmigrates into the body of Vivian Moore, the villainess of the novel, from a family of business CEOs.
All the destruction flags were raised, and Vivian was at the end of her rope. Her life was about to take a turn for the worst, but with Nadia behind the wheel, she seized Fate by the hairs of its head and yanked it into a sharp U-turn.
No more weakness was allowed! If something wanted to get rid of her, she would stab it to death. If someone wanted to trample over her, she would shoot them into a beehive. And there was no stopping her because she had the strongest weapon a main character can have: the System!
the-viltrumite-across-the-worlds:
Jovian Grayson—Mark Grayson’s twin brother and a reincarnated outsider who knows the *Invincible* story—spends seventeen and a half years obsessively training in combat to prepare for the brutal future he expects.
The moment his Viltrumite powers finally awaken, he realizes he’s no longer just surviving: he’s dangerously strong. After effortlessly humiliating a rival boxer and casually overpowering Mark when Mark’s own powers appear, Jovian starts leaning into a darker, more ambitious mindset.
Sensing it, Nolan (Omni-Man) pulls Jovian aside and drops the mask: Viltrumites aren’t Earth’s protectors—they’re conquerors. Nolan believes a prophecy says Jovian is destined to become an extraordinary Viltrumite leader, and Jovian plays along, quickly agreeing to help.
The “first small goal” becomes clear: prepare Jovian with flight, speed, and a proper suit—then move against Earth’s premier super-team, the Guardians of the Globe, as the opening step toward taking over the planet.
towers-richest-player-my-coins-wont-stop:
“Money doesn’t buy happiness. It buys crazy ahh happiness.”
[Ding!]
⟪ You have cleared the 100th Floor of the Tower of Beginning. ⟫
⟪ As the requirements for the completion have been met, the game will now undergo a maintenance period. You will be logged out safely. ⟫
⟪ Rewards for completing the floor will be made available after a maintenance period and a following content will be made available. ⟫
⟪ You will be rewarded the permanent title: Conqueror of the Tower of Beginning, after the maintenance period. ⟫
⟪ Your achievements will be highlighted in the [Akashic records]. ⟫
⟪ May the fortune be on your side. ⟫
Kaizen, ID:KiRA, a 24-year-old streamer and obsessive gamer, etched his name as the only player to conquer the brutal Tower of Beginning, a VRMMO notorious for its punishing difficulty.
Living in a modest two-room apartment, he poured over half a decade into the game, finally conquering the impossible.
But on December 12, 2052, the world flipped: blue countdown screens bearing the tower’s runes appeared globally, and colossal Towers of Cessation erupted, tearing through cities and integrating the game’s system into reality.…
transmigrated-as-a-wrong-character-in-a-:
After dying in laboratory tests, Klaus transmigrated to a Sorcerer World, in a strange and peculiar character whose existence is an enigma.
He knew this world, for it was the world of the novel one of his students wrote. He also knew the character because he created it. But it was a discarded character; it never appeared in the novel.
How could he have transmigrated in it?
Reality hit him soon after when he was sent to cross through the first test that every sorcerer must pass to awaken his abilities.
There, he will have to fight against powerful monsters, which they call Curses, and against other Sorcerers, all to try to enter the select group of Sorcerers to discover the secrets that await in this world and understand his arrival to this and his existence.
Just when he thought his journey might be boring, he received a peculiar and mighty power bordering divinity, capable of making him reach unimaginable heights. Although a bit dangerous...
transmigrated-as-the-villain-between-the:
Kenji’s life was hard. During the day, he worked in a bookstore. At night, he served ramen. He did it all to take care of his family. His mom was sick and needed medicine, and his little sister needed money for school. His best-paying gig was working for a mysterious author, illustrating the manga for a popular web novel. There was just one problem: he hated the story.
He was in the middle of drawing the academy arc when his frustration peaked. The story’s villain, a rich kid named Azrael Ashveil, was weak. He made dumb mistakes and died unfairly. Kenji thought the character deserved better. After finishing a panel showing Hero's Victory, Kenji collapsed from exhaustion.
He wakes up not in his small apartment but in a fancy bed with silk sheets. Looking in the mirror he sees the handsome, violet-eyed face of Azrael Ashveil. He has entered the story he hated and is now the doomed villain.
Worse, he's arrived late to the party. The original Azrael has already made a mess of things. The story's golden-boy hero, Kaelen, already despises him. His beautiful wife, the half-elf heroine Elvara, is terrified of him.…
transmigration-after-becoming-love-saint:
Wang Mu, after playing a martial arts role-playing game for several months and achieving the perfect ending of “Love Saint,” unexpectedly traveled into the game world.
Just when Wang Mu thought he was about to soar, he discovered that thousands of years had already passed in this game world, and it had evolved into the Immortal World...
“Ah, Wang, that's very good. Since you know this, you might as well come and pay respects.”
“Holy crap, isn't this my game character from when I cleared the game, the renowned Love Saint Dongfang Mu?”
versatile-alternate-world:
“You nearly killed me in the past timeline and destroyed my life. Now that I have been given the chance to return to the past timeline, I will be changing everything and fight the future that was meant to be a dead end. Once we meet again, it will never be the same!”
When the only Virtual Reality game called Alternate World made the players gain abilities, the world changed drastically. The whole world undergoes a change of lifestyle, people started to manifest abilities, and playing the game became a job.
Manato Tsukasa, a player who is also one of the players of Alternate World was targeted by his enemies during the evening before his wedding and was almost killed in the process. Due to a certain encounter, he was allowed to gain a second chance to go back to the past and change everything.
With the chance to change everything and start from scratch, he decided to take advantage of all his knowledge and so that he can prepare to kill the person who ruined his life. And to start his vengeance against his enemy, he played the game again that didn't only change the gaming industry but also the whole world.
vice-captain-of-the-straw-hat-pirates:
In the world of pirates, a young man reincarnates into a completely ordinary person's body. But coincidentally, he encounters Monkey D. Luffy.
Hungry for adventures but also scared of death, he joins the Straw Hat Pirates as the vice-captain.
............
Straw Hats will follow the same routes with a lot of new changes.
I am also publishing this story on Royalroad.com
wandering-knight:
The land of Aleisterre is a world of might and magic, sword and sorcery, where wandering knights and mysterious gods shape the fate of kingdoms. Wang Yu, a resourceful and unorthodox protagonist, finds himself inexplicably pulled into Aleisterre, a place steeped in ancient powers and political intrigue. With little understanding of the magic and faith that underpin this realm, Wang Yu is thrust into conflicts he never sought out—yet must navigate carefully if he’s to survive.
Official blurb:
Dragons' wings cut through the sky. Knights charge forward, magic tearing apart everything before them. Wizardry distorts the fabric of reality itself. The steam revolution stirs in one kingdom; the endless seas echo with ancient, distorted calls. Gods rule from high above, and the dark abyss leads deep underground.
Wang Yu, from Earth, arrives in this unfamiliar world of fantasy.
Straightforward and practical to the extreme, Wang Yu hates politics, despises intrigue, and prefers to approach everything head-on. In his own way, he leaves his mark in this mad, chaotic world.
“I don’t care to listen to or understand my enemy’s story.”
“I'm the tank, and you're the carry.…
worldwide-class-change-got-a-frost-fruit:
Wang Yu crossed to an alternate world and found that here the game became a reality. A large number of monsters appeared in the Blue Star, and various secret realms and dungeons were everywhere.
People found they could get a lot of rewards for killing monsters, and the era of worldwide class change started.
At the class-change ceremony, Wang Yu found he became the most unpromising class, Fisherman.
When the system loaded, everything was different.
He found that he could obtain various rewards through fishing.
He got Frozen Fruits by angling. He raised his hand and froze everything like it was the Ice Age!
Fishing for foreign fire, casting the Buddha’s Angry Fire Lotus, burning all magical beasts!
Fishing wood, he became the Buddha and all races were shocked!
In addition, there was also divine equipment, mythical pet eggs, and all kinds of strange props.
When Wang Yu made it to the top of the ten thousand races, everyone was shocked.
“You call this a life-type occupation Fisherman?”
